methodology: APPROXIMATE — tokens derived by tokenizing logged text (output/anthropic_dossier.json, output/anthropic_output.json) with tiktoken cl100k_base as an offline stand-in for Claude's real (undisclosed) tokenizer, plus reconstructed prompt templates from the actual pipeline code (greenbone/clan.py, tasks/research/task.py). NOT a measurement of real Anthropic API `usage` fields. Token counts are identical across the Tiered and All-Head configs by construction; only the price applied differs, so tokenizer bias cancels out of the %-cost-reduction ratio. See tools/estimate_tokens.py module docstring for the full list of labeled assumptions (A1-A9) and the PRICING NOTE.
